contributions: Go-authoritative edge backend with Python kept as spec-only artifacts (ADR-001).
Evidence boundary with ports/adapters and doubles for external systems (ADR-004).
Read-only investigation agents with an explicit denied-tool inventory (ADR-008).
OCR-confidence gate routing low-confidence documents to human review (ADR-009).

ADR-001.limits: States Go-authoritative backend with Python as spec-only; parity status of any specific module must be checked in code, not assumed from this ADR.
ADR-001.summary: Go is the authoritative edge backend; Python artifacts are specs and harnesses. Cross-language behavior is pinned by fixtures/golden_cases.json.

ADR-004.limits: Covers architecture and test doubles; does not prove production behavior against live third-party systems.
ADR-004.summary: External evidence enters through ports/adapters with Mockoon doubles in tests; paise-int64 money handling at the boundary.

ADR-008.limits: Inventory table is a design-time record; runtime enforcement must be confirmed against the current agent code before claiming enforcement.
ADR-008.summary: Investigation agents are read-only: no APPROVE/DENY/PAY authority. Denied tool T11 documents the exact mutation boundary.

ADR-009.limits: Threshold value and placeholder policy verified in source text only; OCR pipeline pass rates need dated run evidence.
ADR-009.summary: OCRConfidence value object with inclusive IsLow(0.85) gate routes low-confidence documents to human review; placeholder 1.0 is never trusted.

ci-deterministic.env: CI ubuntu-latest (config verified; individual run links not yet recorded)
ci-deterministic.limits: Proves the gates exist and what they cover; does not by itself prove any single run passed — link dated runs before claiming passes.
ci-deterministic.scope: gofmt, go vet, live-secret guards, build-tag isolation, go test ./..., scoped -race, LiteParse live smoke (hard fail), pytest tests/unit, ruff, mypy strict, terraform validate

limitations: Groq qwen3 live-model qualification is In progress (manual gate, not CI) — do not present as qualified.
Parser corpus figures (45 cases etc.) are Tested at most until the v1 evaluation report and dated runs are verified.
Postgres/RLS and Mockoon contracts are emulator/CI-scoped; managed-cloud qualification is Blocked/Unqualified pending project and billing decisions.
No production deployment, business-outcome, or performance claims are supported by these records.
claimops.problem: Health-insurance claims need evidence-weighing and exception handling where the AI must never approve, deny, or pay.
claimops.tagline: Health-insurance claims investigation with bounded AI reasoning and human oversight. The AI investigates; it never approves, denies, or pays.

contributions: Hybrid deterministic + LLM layering: engines compute in Decimal, agents only render language (ADR-001).
Absolute no-math boundary for the LLM, enforced by a CI arithmetic gate (ADR-007).
Seven-stage validation harness with no-skip enforcement and a final circuit breaker (ADR-009).
Hard trust boundary with RAG disabled by default and audit-before-AI ordering (ADR-015).

ADR-001.limits: Describes the intended layering; per-module compliance (e.g. finance/ LLM-free) must be confirmed in code before claiming enforcement.
ADR-001.summary: Deterministic finance engines own all math (Decimal-only); LLM agents are read-only renderers behind a typed assertion pipeline.

ADR-007.limits: Text verified in source; CI arithmetic-gate behavior and prompt-template compliance need workflow run evidence.
ADR-007.summary: The LLM never performs arithmetic of any kind; every figure originates from deterministic engines and is cross-checked post-render.

ADR-009.limits: Harness design verified in source; per-stage pass evidence needs dated integration/evaluation runs.
ADR-009.summary: Seven validation stages with no-skip enforcement and defined hard/soft failure modes ending in an executive-summary circuit breaker.

ADR-015.limits: RAG-disabled and audit-before-AI are stated policy; tenant-config and audit-chain evidence needed to claim deployment compliance.
ADR-015.summary: Hard trust boundary (verified assertions in, language out), RAG disabled by default, audit-before-AI ordering for production promotion.

decisions.limits: Summary mirror of the ADR rationale; canonical detail lives in the individual ADRs linked above.
decisions.summary: Decision log covering Sheets scope, Pydantic validation, structured outputs, context packs, evidence-backed claims, and trust boundary.

ai-evals-manual-gate.limits: Live-model evaluation is unqualified until a controlled manual eval is executed and its results recorded with dates.
ai-evals-manual-gate.scope: Controlled LLM eval gate; explicitly performs no provider calls in CI

ci-deterministic.env: CI ubuntu-latest (config verified; individual run links not yet recorded)
ci-deterministic.limits: Proves the gates exist and what they cover; does not by itself prove any single run passed — link dated runs before claiming passes.
ci-deterministic.scope: ruff, ruff format, secret-leak rg gate, mypy baseline ratchet, pytest tests/unit + tests/contract

finsight.problem: FP&A teams need variance commentary they can trust: LLMs hallucinate numbers, purely deterministic systems can't explain them.
finsight.tagline: Financial reconciliation and exception resolution with deterministic controls; the agent investigates and proposes, humans approve auditable actions.
